about: St Ives Surf School has its surf HQ on Porthmeor Beach and a watersports centre on Porthminster Beach. It hires surfboards, wetsuits and bodyboards at Porthmeor and paddleboards and kayaks at Porthminster, and runs lessons, tours and coasteering.
where: Porthmeor Beach (surf hire) and Porthminster Beach (SUP and kayak hire), St Ives
season: Listed as open every day; no dates given
gaps: Hire terms and inclusions were not stated.
